newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks fall through 1,700-point barrier.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks fall through 1,700-point barrier.

text.p: Pakistani stocks fell past the 1,700-point mark to end 2.45 percent down on Thursday as small investors took profits in blue chips, dealers said.
Selling by retail investors dampened market sentiment, prompting price falls across the board, one dealer said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended 42.60 points down at 1,699.39 amid 258 losers and 72 gainers.
Lever Bros fell 10 rupees to 730, PSO 9.00 to 311, Engro 9.00 to 185 and Shell Pakistan 5.00 to 205. PTCL shed 0.90 to 29.90 and HUBCO 1.00 to 40.55.
